spacing_and_layout.philosophy: Generous Spacing, Optical Alignment, Crisp Edges

components.navigation: Sticky nav with glassmorphism (backdrop-blur-xl). Contains Logo ('Quantum'), Links (About, Resources, Updates), and Dark/Light Mode Toggle. Must be visible on desktop.
components.footer: Generous padding (py-20). Contains standard links and a 'Faculty Portal' link with a small lock icon.
components.cards: Flat background, 1px subtle border (border-border), sharp corners. No heavy drop shadows. On hover: slight lift (-translate-y-1) and border color darkening/lightening.
components.buttons: Sharp corners. Primary CTA uses brand color. High contrast text.
components.forms: Shadcn UI inputs. 1px solid borders. Focus state: ring-2 of primary color.

hero_background.description: Abstract futuristic processor representing quantum computing. Use with heavy overlay (e.g. bg-black/60) to ensure text contrast.

about_students.description: Diverse university students on campus representing RV University.

Home.instructions: Hero section with large 'QUANTUM' text (text-5xl to 6xl+) in Cabinet Grotesk. Subtitle 'RV University Physics & Quantum Computing Club'. High contrast. Call to actions for Resources and Updates. Below hero, a quick Bento grid highlighting the mission and recent announcements.

About.instructions: Editorial layout. Large typography. Use the chalkboard and students images. Sections for Mission, Faculty Leads, and Club Activities.

Resources.instructions: Publicly accessible grid of resources. Each card shows title, category (Notes, Textbooks, PPTs), and a download button. Minimalist, tech-forward design.

Updates.instructions: Social-feed style layout. A central column of update cards. Each card has faculty avatar, name, timestamp (in mono font), message, and an optional image.

Faculty_Login.instructions: Simple, centered login card with Email and Password inputs. For now, on submit, simply route to the Faculty Dashboard shell.

Faculty_Dashboard_Shell.instructions: Accessible after login. Simple layout with a sidebar or top sub-nav. Two main forms: 1) Upload Resource (Title, Category select, File input placeholder, Submit) and 2) Post Update (Message textarea, Image URL input, Submit). Purely frontend UI for now.

technical_requirements.testing: All interactive elements MUST have data-testid attributes (e.g. data-testid='faculty-login-button').
technical_requirements.fonts: Include Cabinet Grotesk, IBM Plex Sans, and JetBrains Mono from Google Fonts or Fontshare.
